title: Bevan's stone-cutter farewell line never updates across three different, mutually exclusive story states (unsettled wording / a wording brokered and cut / the warrant fully refused and the stone shelved for good), always saying the same thing: 'It's held that stone's wording a long time, waiting on someone to settle it.' By the third state this is flatly false — it has been settled, twice over, in opposite directions.
where: The Stone-Cutter's Lodge, leaving Bevan (every visit after the first)
